rstream-only.detail: select rstream * over length(3): silent until 4th event expires first

rstream-insert-into.detail: insert into strips rstream: consumer sees all 4 inserts, s0 fires expiry

rstream-insert-into-rstream.detail: insert rstream into: only removals forwarded to consumer

rstream-join.detail: rstream join: fires when first a expires from length(2)

istream-only.detail: select istream * over length(1): inserts only, expiries suppressed

istream-insert-into-rstream.detail: istream source + insert rstream into: s0 fires inserts, consumer gets expiry

istream-join.detail: istream join: fires once on match, silent on expiry

notes: istream/rstream selector semantics verified: remove-stream-only fires on window expiry as new data, insert-into without rstream keyword strips selector (consumer sees inserts), insert rstream into forwards only removals, join selectors filter insert/remove join output. OM/Compile variants are compile-API duplicates of RStreamOnly; RStreamOutputSnapshot is a compile-deploy-undeploy smoke test without observable rows, excluded from this slice. Java insert-into with independent select-selector vs route-mode is modeled in Go as two statements over the same windowed source (selector listener + routing statement).
